cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to letter a cake; use that handwriting on our prize certificate before you frame it. Put my name under 'cake design'.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You finally remembered a name without a prompt. Next year's members won't know it; write it in while there's space.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then list everyone with what they did. I'll fetch the names; you leave enough room beside mine. You've learnt to fit more than one name on a cake, haven't you?
